sentences.text:
=
 Appearance :
 For the Appellant/s : Mr. Baijnath Sah, Adv.
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Syed Ashfaque Ahmad, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Chandra Shekhar Jha

It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that the prayer of bail and suspension of this appellant was rejected earlier by this Court vide order dated 14.12.2023 and now the present petition is again filed for early hearing of the appellant in view of Section 374(4) of the Cr.P.C. where appeal is to be disposed of preferably within 6 months of filing this appeal as same is against conviction under Section 376 of the I.P.C. and Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
2.
Considering the aforesaid, the present petition is allowed and disposed of accordingly.
Office is directed to list this matter on 28.08.2024 for final hearing, retaining its position.

(Chandra Shekhar Jha, J) Sudha/-
